title: CBRS IPO lockup ends — Cerebras Systems, 180 days after its 2026-05-13 prospectus
source: EST: the lock-up has an early-release trigger, so shares can unlock before this date. 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2021728/000162828026035214/cerebras-424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-05-13 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-11-09. Lock-up clause: "Eastern Time on the second trading day following our release of earnings for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 or (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the "Lock-up Period"), subject to certain customary exceptions and provision s that provide for the early release of certain of our securities during …"
notes: Initial research 2026-10-20 (424B4 re-read in full). The lock-up is STAGED, not a single cliff: the 424B4 table releases ~171.1M shares in tranches from the IPO's first trading day through 2026-10-28 (the last dated tranche, ~19.4M shares), and 'all remaining shares' unlock at the earlier of 6:00 a.m. ET on the second trading day after the Q3 2026 earnings release or 180 days after the prospectus (2026-11-09). By the filing's own arithmetic that final step covers ~14M shares (215.1M total less 30M sold in the IPO less 171.1M already released; excludes the OpenAI-warrant Class N shares and RSUs vesting by 11-09). 2026-11-09 is the LATEST the final release can happen; it moves earlier only if Cerebras reports Q3 on or before 2026-11-04 (on its Q2 cadence the report lands ~11-11/11-12). Kept estimate for that reason, not because the 180-day date is in doubt. See docs/research/events/cbrs-lockup-expiry-2026-11-09.md.
